description: Ministry of Public Administration & Management - Amendment to the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service Minute, published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1670/33 of 10.09.2010
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the revision of the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service Minute, detailing recruitment criteria, educational qualifications, professional qualifications, experience requirements, and interview marking schemes for public service positions. It falls under Public Service Gazettes as it specifically addresses public service recruitment procedures, qualification standards, and examination processes administered by the Public Service Commission.
